description: Drinkwater gebiedsdossiers is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. De drinkwaterkaart Zuid-Holland geeft informatie weer over de drinkwatervoorziening in de provincie Zuid-Holland. Hierbij gaat het over de locaties van de grondwaterbeschermingsgebieden en bijbehorende gebiedsdossiers, de voorzieningsgebieden van de Zuid-Hollandse drinkwaterbedrijven en hoofdelementen van de productielocaties/zuiveringsstappen. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are drinkwater, gebiedsdossier. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
